svg.title: Mature-miRNA prediction: study performance comparisons
svg.desc: Original cancer-excluded TCGA ridge input comparisons, final P1 and SiCmiR in CPTAC-3, and P1, P2, fixed Hallmark kernel and SiCmiR in liver. Populations, target coverage and model stages differ. External-cohort whiskers are saved 95 percent bootstrap intervals for the means; TCGA values are pooled point estimates.
